description.value: Yah-Yah-Ya is Richmond's outpost of a Tokyo-origin ramen chain, opened in 2014 as the brand's first overseas location. The kitchen specialises in Yokohama Iekei-style ramen, built on a tonkotsu-chicken broth simmered daily for at least 12 hours from pork backbones, pork knuckles, and chicken bones — no concentrated stock. A touring cyclist stopping here gets a substantial, deeply flavoured bowl in an indoor-only setting inside what appears to be a shopping-centre food court.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address exactly (8388 Capstan Way #1423, Richmond, BC V6X 4B6). A phone number (+1 604-285-5113) appears on the /contact subpage but is absent from OSM tags. The gallery explicitly lists 'Veg. Mountain Vegan Ramen', confirming a vegan menu item; Uber Eats, Doordash, and Fantuan integrations confirm third-party delivery/takeout availability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
